title: Renew a licence to carry out taxidermy or possess preserved specimens
summary: This page explains how to renew a taxidermy licence or licence to possess preserved specimens.
intro:
If you hold a taxidermy licence, you need to renew it before the expiry date.

Before renewing, you must return the specimen record and transaction form with:

You do this online by submitting the Specimen record and transaction form.
who_can_apply: Must hold a taxidermy licence and renew it before the expiry date.
what_you_need: The report after completing the Specimen record and transaction form
The PDF form ‘Licence to Possess Preserved Specimens and/or Carry Out Taxidermy – Renewal’

how_to_steps.text: Submit your application by email to the details on the form.

more_info.text: You do not need a licence to keep or carry out taxidermy on non-native animals or hold processed animal products.
You cannot sell or trade animal specimens, even if you do not want to keep it. If you’re a professional taxidermist, you may advertise and charge for your taxidermy services.

faqs.q: Do I need to renew my taxidermy licence?
faqs.a: Yes, if you hold a taxidermy licence, you must renew it before the expiry date.

faqs.q: How do I renew my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence online by submitting the Specimen record and transaction form.

faqs.q: What do I need to renew my licence?
faqs.a: You need the report after completing the Specimen record and transaction form, the PDF form ‘Licence to Possess Preserved Specimens and/or Carry Out Taxidermy – Renewal’, and payment for the renewal fee.
